title: Prospective qualification of robust fast RK4 0.005-day policy
central_question: Does the prospectively promoted compiled RK4 dt=0.005 day policy provide robust, fidelity-preserving and computationally advantageous execution for frozen S4/G8 across an expanded six-material panel?

authority.representation_authority: ROM-PRACTICAL first benchmark and P3 closeout

panel.note: B06/B12 are fresh for the 60-day P3/P4 workload but not globally blind because they appeared in earlier short-horizon ROM work.

gates.robustness: All 12 purpose/material cases complete with finite qualified-domain states and max water ledger <=1e-8 cm.
gates.equation_conformance: Independent compiled/Python probes pass the existing 5e-12 scaled absolute gate.
gates.fidelity_preservation: Report the same P3 purpose metrics versus R128 and R64-vs-R128; no new application threshold.
gates.speed: RK4_0.005/R128 median wall ratio <1 for every one of the 12 cases.
gates.extension_speed: Both B06 and B12 must satisfy the speed gate for both purposes.
gates.practical_research_viability: robustness AND speed AND equation conformance; this is not application acceptance.

interpretation: P5 may establish a practical research numerical implementation, not equivalence to full SWAP.
Hydrological errors from S4/G8 representation remain explicit and are not repaired by the numerical policy.
Same-runner process timings are workload-specific and non-portable.
B06/B12 extend numerical/material coverage; they do not make this a fresh application validation.
